_about.role: Single Source of Truth (SSOT) authority file for narrative characters, companions and props.
_about.rule: Source files and prompts never contain a written-out name or a written-out variant. Use tokens: {{id}}, {{id:first}}, {{id:full}}, {{id:<form>}}.
_about.example: This registry is the repository's own example: three people, two props, one scene file, one art manifest, one token source, continuity cards, a shot sheet, two render surfaces, a prompt template, and a story folder (examples/story: scene records, two editions, parked art, built output).

invariants.name: Bob Barker approved of Theo
invariants.why: Bob Barker was not alive when Sam met Theo; Bob Barker never met Theo on their date.

exclusive_markers.why: a scene labelled one time of day may not describe the other; the label and the text are edited by different hands

forbid_keys.why: a scene's description lives once, on the scene; the art manifest keeps slot, src and prompt only

exclusive_markers.why: a shot planned for the evening may not describe daylight; the other values' words become the block's AVOID line
a shot planned in the kitchen may not describe the workbench

token_sources.why: reading orders hold slugs only; a reason or note that names a character writes a token
the parked and removed lists hold file names and reasons; never a typed name
a test edit names a character by token and is resolved before the text is searched; the applied record quotes drafts as tokens

story-scene.name: Story scene
story-scene.style_lock: painted graphic-novel panel, muted palette, visible brush texture, one light source
must_keep: faces as in the anchor pictures
props exactly as described, nothing added to them
story-scene.hands_rule: every hand shows all five fingers, none extra, none merged
story-scene.why: a page of the story: nothing on it may look like merchandise, and the letterer places every word later

product-card.name: Product card
product-card.style_lock: studio product photograph on a white sweep, soft even light
must_keep: the prop sealed in a clear blister pack on a printed cardboard backing
the prop centred, nothing else in frame
product-card.no_text: no text except the card's own printed label
product-card.why: a shop card for the prop: here the packaging is the point, and the story's rules do not apply

chloe-jenkins.name: Chloe
chloe-jenkins.role: Lead protagonist, mental health clinician and narrator

forms.look: a Black woman in her late thirties with deep brown skin and a close-cropped natural cut
a mixed-race woman in her early thirties with warm brown skin, dark curly hair and a small scar through her left eyebrow
a tall white man in his thirties with sandy hair, a short beard and a chipped front tooth

brass-key.name: the brass key
brass-key.role: The workshop key Theo carries; a tracked object a scene lists by id, never by matching its name in prose
brass-key.prompt_tokens: a small tarnished brass key on a frayed red thread

cracked-phone.name: the cracked phone
cracked-phone.role: Sam's phone, the object the kitchen scene turns on; listed by id on scenes and cards, held by whoever the shot sheet says
cracked-phone.prompt_tokens: a black phone with a cracked corner in a clear case
